Nunu is still a boy, not an adult/grim soldier: brown hair, warm natural skin, friendly determined gaze, worn red northern hood/scarf and muted blue wool/hide winter coat. Willump is still friendly and magical, not an ordinary feral troop: broad blue nose, white and blue-gray coarse fur, clear blue face planes, warm brown short swept horns and distinctive white brow tufts. Friendly gentle eye shape, but smaller natural pupils/irises and a restrained tiny highlight. No oversized glossy glass eyes, inflated round plush cheeks, Disney/Pixar faces, doll skin, smooth plastic or modern animated-film rendering.
Composition repair is critical: place the TWO FACES SIDE BY SIDE with eyes near THE SAME HEIGHT, rather than a tiny boy low below the giant yeti. Nunu head occupies left40%, Willump head right60%, heads close and gently leaning together. Willump may be somewhat larger, but Nunu's whole hood/head and Willump's whole horn/brow silhouette must BOTH FIT within the CENTRAL60%of canvas height. Keep all key identity shapes in a central wide face band so a48x32 landscape crop AND58x64 portrait crop retain both recognizable complete faces including Willump's brow/horns. Do not hide either face behind the other; no extra person/body.
Rendering MUST look like an original late1990s Heroes of Might and Magic III hero portrait: textured oil-painted miniature over prerendered sculpted planes, compact realistic anatomy, sharper angular forehead/nose/cheek/muzzle forms, strong clear upper-left light, deep cool brown/blue shadow shapes and economical warm highlights. Subtle weathered skin and coarse matte hair/fur, tactile rough wool/hide. Keep kind expressions through natural mouth/eye posture, not through cartoonishly huge eyes or rounded toy cheeks. No arbitrary pixel filter, no vector outline, no flat posterization, no glossy contemporary3D.

Warm face against cooler background and clear redhood. Avoid full white-on-white silhouette loss, dark void, flat dull gray, fog over faces, lighting aura, weapons, text, logos, frames, borders or UI. Independent new painting, preserve identities and improve rendering/framing only.
